name: Courtfall
description: A two-player arena skirmish: five exiles each, fatigue as both action economy and health, secret dice allocation in every exchange, and a personal Clear Turn that cashes the crowd's favor into victory points.
rules: Goal: be the first to 5 victory points (VP). VP is only bought during your own Clear Turn, with Momentum (blue stones, at most 5): the first VP of a Clear costs 2, the second 3, the third 4.

Setup (Courtfall Third Edition): on the 37-hex arena, Light (seat 1) and Dark (seat 2) alternate replacing tan tiles with 4 Overgrowth, 3 Mire and 3 Hazard tiles — never in a back-two-rows deployment zone, never on the Eye (the centre), no two Hazards adjacent and no special tile touching more than two other special tiles (the literal wording, applied to every tile, leaves room for only eight tiles on this board, so it is read as applying to special tiles; a tile may only be laid where the draft can still be finished). Light drafts first. Then each player picks a Court (Dark first) and the two alternate deploying their five units in their back two rows, Light first. Dark takes the first turn. (Light and Dark stand in for the rules' roll-off: the loser drafts and deploys first, the winner plays first.)

A turn: take your free recovery (remove one white stone from one of your units — a Gale Court may instead turn one black stone white), then exactly one of: Activate a Fresh unit (2 actions, then it gains a white stone), Exert a Fatigued unit (1 action, then its white stone becomes black), or take a Clear Turn. Before choosing you may spend Momentum on a Surge (1: shift a non-Exhausted unit one hex) or Rouse (2: remove a black stone). After finishing a turn you may Seize the Tempo (2 Momentum) for an immediate extra turn — never twice in succession.

Conditions: Fresh units act fully and roll their full Combat Value (CV: Warden 3, Outrider 3, Arbalest 2, Juggernaut 3, Champion 4); Fatigued (white stone) roll one die fewer and can only Exert; Exhausted (black stone) have one defense die and cannot act. Units are never removed. Hits and acting wear down the same track.

Actions of an activated unit: Move (Warden 3, Outrider 4 leaping, Arbalest 3, Juggernaut 3 in a straight line, Champion 4 — Mire ends a move, entering a Hazard costs a Hit), Strike an adjacent enemy, Shoot (Arbalest only: 2–4 hexes along a clear line), or Shove an adjacent enemy.

A Strike is a secret exchange: you split your CV between attack and defense dice and commit; your opponent then does the same without knowing your split; all dice roll at once. A die succeeds on 6, or on 5 / 4 with one / two Edges (Flanking, Worn Down, Charge, Isolation for attack; Overgrowth against shots and Shieldwall for defense). More successes than the enemy's defense is a Hit — the counter-attack lands in the same instant; ties go to defense; winning by 2 or more also pushes the loser a hex. Each side may spend 1 Momentum to reroll one of its failed dice.

Hits: Fresh becomes Fatigued, Fatigued becomes Exhausted (the attacker gains 1 Momentum, plus 1 more for exhausting the Champion); an already Exhausted unit is pushed a hex instead and the attacker gains nothing. Pushing an enemy into a Hazard or off the edge earns 1 Momentum.

Courts: Bastion (all your units hold Shieldwall beside a non-Exhausted friend), Gale (nurse black stones with your free recovery), Stone (swap two empty tiles within 2 hexes at the start of a turn, once per Clear), Cinder (shoves push one hex further and pushing into fire pays 1 extra Momentum), Veiled (Isolation edge against enemies with no non-Exhausted friend beside them).

Because every decision of a turn is a move in this implementation, a turn is a sequence of small moves: pick the unit, then each action, then answer any exchange. The game ends after 2000 plies on VP (equal VP is a draw).

options.label: Standard arena (no terrain draft)
options.text: Lay a fixed, symmetric arena instead of drafting one: ten decisions fewer before the first move, and the same ground every game, which is what a batch of bot games needs.

green.label: Overgrowth
green.text: Blocks ranged line of sight through it; a unit in it holds a defensive Edge against shots.

blue.label: Mire
blue.text: Entering ends a Move action; a unit in it rolls one die fewer in every contest.

red.label: Hazard
red.text: A unit that enters or is pushed into it suffers a Hit and stays there.

eye.label: The Eye
eye.text: A non-Exhausted unit here at the start of your Clear Turn earns 1 Momentum.

zone-1.label: Light's deployment zone
zone-1.text: Light deploys its units in these two rows; no special tile may lie here.

zone-2.label: Dark's deployment zone
zone-2.text: Dark deploys its units in these two rows; no special tile may lie here.

fatigued.label: Fatigued
fatigued.text: White stone: one die fewer, can only Exert.

exhausted.label: Exhausted
exhausted.text: Black stone: one defense die, cannot act.

target.label: Target
target.text: Part of the exchange being resolved.

terms.bastion: Bastion Court — Shieldwall is contagious: all your units hold its defensive Edge while beside a non-Exhausted friend.
terms.gale: Gale Court — your free recovery may instead turn one black stone into a white stone.
terms.stone: Stone Court — at the start of a turn swap two unoccupied tiles within 2 hexes (once per Clear Turn).
terms.cinder: Cinder Court — your shoves push one extra hex and pushing into a Hazard or off the edge pays 1 extra Momentum.
terms.veiled: Veiled Court — your units hold the Isolation attack Edge against enemies with no non-Exhausted friend adjacent.
